static_SQL_review.syntax: No confirmed SQL/PLpgSQL syntax defect found by static inspection. Real PG18 parser/deparser remains NOT_RUN; SOURCE mocks do not establish SQL execution validity.
static_SQL_review.null: NOT NULL prevents physical NULL columns; JSON null/missing extractions refuse via IS TRUE/IS NOT TRUE/IS DISTINCT FROM. Existing revision1 weak CHECKs are preserved; new guard independently validates the actual M1 root.
static_SQL_review.canonical_ref: Mission predecessor object equality pins exact field set, mission kind, canonical root UUID string, revision1, original digest; count enforces exactly one mission predecessor. Numeric equality is supplemented by ->> spelling to reject retained1.0 forms. Other basis refs/full MissionSpec/envelope/digest validation remain backend constructor responsibilities for the next slice.
static_SQL_review.raw_JSON_limit: JSONB is a parsed representation and does not preserve original duplicate keys/number token spelling. The ->> check constrains the stored numeric text, not arbitrary raw JSON lexical forms such as an exponent normalized before storage. This review does not credit a raw-CanonicalJSON/digest verifier; that backend responsibility is explicitly deferred by the normative decision. If raw-wire lexical refusal is intended as a SQL-foundation acceptance criterion, the parent must resolve that stronger contract before promoting it.
